content: Thlǝd fiya Yeeso fa tǝ wutsǝfayirha a Urshalima
Takhna Yeeso tǝ fatsahayighǝn a ndusang Urshalima fa, ɓa nda Mbetafaji ɓa tǝ Mbetani na a Wumngya Ɗǝfya Dzaitun, thlǝngga Yeeso sǝri ahur fatsahayighǝn a ˈwa nda mbeeɗǝ.
Ndanggǝn kanda, “Ɗaama ahu talɗa ɗǝ na a mbennun taarha, a kyaɗun sahai, nun a na wan kwaara ƙǝƙǝna hai ˈwawana nanda tǝraa. Kwasaman hai, ɓon ɓa tǝghǝn.
A tsahang niifa mee kun, ‘kama nun a ǝnaarha kee?’ ndaman, ‘Chinǝm ndagha na midghǝnsǝ nǝn a wuɗang ɓa wed.’ ”
Ɗǝgha fatsahayina ɗǝ ɗa nda wal wan kwarɗi a mii kwamana, ƙǝƙǝna hai a kwatkirma. Na nanda a kwasang hai,
nafiya na ƙǝƙǝt a mbǝɗi tsahang mee nda kanda, “Ma nun a ǝnaarha, kama nun a kwasang wan kwarɗa hai?”
Pǝr ǝnɗa nda thlǝghangna Yeeso kanda, malangga nafini kanda.
Ɓang wan kwarɗa nda Yeeso ɓa muwangganda parkoyindan a ƙǝsǝrghǝn sǝ.
Fiya hangga lǝlǝɓangganda kootoyindan hai ahu kwamana, fingya kyath shiiya nda ɓa lǝlǝɓangganda hai.
Nagha fiya na a samadghǝn tǝ yi mbedghǝn ahuhwaarha,

content.text: Tǝ parkani niifɗi ɓagha ɓa ahu thlǝm Chinǝm!

content: Ɗǝna Yeeso Urshalima ɗǝ kyagha ahu Ƙǝn hwan Faara ɗǝ. Ƙǝlanggǝn mbǝya heu, amma tsaunǝn hǝm yanfaara hai, kyagha sǝ tǝ fatsahayighǝn ɗǝnda Mbetani ɗǝ.
Shiwang Yeeso ɗǝf shiɓarha
Ɗathna mbǝrha hai na nanda a mal Mbetani, nagha miirha a ƙǝs Yeeso.
Ƙǝla nǝn ɗǝ na ɗǝf shiɓarha nǝn ɗǝ tǝ shee fa, ɗǝgha kamughǝn ɗǝ ƙǝlanggǝn tǝnǝn wal wanggǝn. Ndusang nǝn fa, mbǝ ˈyasǝ wal nǝn a uradghǝn wa ƙǝl shiiya, ƙǝsǝr shifidghǝnni wa.
Tǝrgha ndanggǝn ɗǝfǝdɗi, “A nggǝr niifa kii ɗǝfǝd wa ɓalwa pakwanɗǝ.” Sǝkka fatsahayighǝn ˈya ndanǝn.
Rǝghang Yeeso fa shafiliya ɗǝ a Ƙǝn Faara

Sǝlna Yeeso tǝ fatsahayighǝn a Urshalima ɗǝ, kyagha a pǝpal Ƙǝn Faara ɗǝ ƙatǝranggǝn rǝghang nda nafiya ɗǝ na a ǝna shafili a mbǝɗi. Chaggǝlanggǝn tebǝrya fa mbeɗed wuɗǝɓǝla tǝ kulohod fa heng kataprakkya,
mbǝ malang niifa mbǝrgha ɗǝ tǝ ǝn shafili tǝ pǝpal Ƙǝn Faara wa.
Tsahanggǝn kanda ha ndǝghǝn, “Nǝghǝn chichirethlee hai ahu ɗeleewar Faara tǝ ndaarha,

Mamnda firistaya tǝ famalǝmngya ngyakhrha sǝk nanda ǝnɗi katǝragha hai katǝrang ngganda kaɗa kwamana hai na a ɓǝlangganda. Amma kanda a tǝrǝmnggǝn, ƙǝsǝr fiya heu tsahadghǝn ha nǝghǝn a fǝrang ǝnwulteena kanda.
Tsǝna figrha hai, Yeeso tǝ fatsahayighǝn kya nda sǝ a wupǝri ɗi.
Tsaharhaha aten shiɓadɗi
A tsar, na nanda a wiirha, na shiɓadɗa nda hwarɗaɗǝ tǝ thlaryighǝn.
Ɗalghǝna Mbiturus ndǝn in ndanggǝn Yeeso, “Mala! Kuloɗǝ! Ɗǝfǝd shiɓadɗi shiwangna na!”
Tǝrgha ndangga Yeeso fatsahayini, “Fǝrama ƙǝkafek a Faara.
Niya pǝrang ƙǝkafek kun, a ndang niifa wumndǝɗi ya, ‘Ɗǝwaɗǝ, ɗa muwang fadwa a wuri aama ɗǝ,’ a ngaal wa ahurghǝn wa amma fǝrɗǝ ƙǝkafek tǝ ndaarha ˈya thlǝknǝn nǝn a katǝrarha hai, nanda a ǝnanggǝn.
Tsaunǝn kee niya ndang nda kun, kala ˈya na minnun a hwanang ɗun Faara, tǝ ƙǝkafekkirha, nun a walghǝn.
A naɗun a hwan Faara, ˈwaama teena chahang ɗimiyid ndan nun fingya ɗǝ ǝnangga ɗimiyirha kun fa, tǝna yinun Chiina na a talara chahang ɗimiyid nun kun ɗǝ.
Amma a chakhkun ɗimiyirha wa, mbǝ yinun Chiina na a talara a chahang ɗimiyid nun kun ɗǝ wa.”
Mamngya Yahudaya tsahang nda mee Yeeso
Nggǝrna Yeeso ɓaarha Urshalima ɓa, ndǝghǝn a wiirha hai a pǝpal Ƙǝn Faara, Mamnda firistaya, famalǝmngya ngyakhrha tǝ shingya ɓaa nda thlǝmadghǝn ɓa.
Tsahang mee nda, “Tǝ tur yanggi ngyahadyi na ǝna ǝngginiya, wun furowa kwaman ǝna ǝnɗiya?”
Nggǝmangga Yeeso kanda, “Niya tsahang mee kun ha tal. A nggǝreeɗun sǝ, niya pǝranggǝn kun tǝ wun fǝreegha kwamana niya ǝna ǝngginiya.
Wun fǝrangga kwamana Yahaya ǝna mbaptisǝma nǝn? Faara fǝrangga wa, nduwa fiya wa? Pǝreemadghǝn!”
Tǝrgha thliigha ngaala sǝ a pathlang ndan, ndaa nda, “A ndaa ɗǝm, ‘a talara ni hai,’ nǝn a tsakh mee, ‘Kama fǝrangwa nun ƙǝkafek?’
A ndaa ɗǝm, Fiya fǝrangga.” Na nda a tǝrǝm fiya, ƙǝsǝr sǝn fiya sǝ Yahaya annabini.
Ndang ngganda Yeeso, “Sǝngwan wa.” Ndangga Yeeso kanda, “Nggi ƙǝm mbi pǝranggǝn kun tǝ wunni fǝreegha ngyakhrha niya ǝna ǝngginiya wa.”
